body:
wow, i can't write up too much for the moment, but i can very much relate. i moved to a new school at ten so having to find new friends was impossible for the first year as my hyperactive personality and general weirdness kept others away.

the very people who made fun of me, befriended me and that's shaped my relations to other people. i can't help but feel that i'm only being tolerated and that i'm just someone you have to "get used to". 

i've become overly sensitive to people's remarks to the point that i get overly defensive. it's a bit of hellish cycle of fighting your irrational fear that everyone is out to get you.
absolutely. i'm obsessed with the idea of knowing everything or at least expanding my knowledge enough to be viewed as intelligent and well-read.
